text: A muscular male figure with dark brown skin stands center-frame. He has long, black, wavy hair falling past his shoulders, a thick brow ridge, and an open mouth showing teeth. His face is broad and angular. He wears no clothing except a thin white band around his upper right arm. In his right hand he grips a reddish-brown staff with a dark tip. He appears to be walking forward through a blue-tinged icy environment.
